notes: All cases are synthetic examples of expected behavior, not passed clinical tests.
Baseline behavior for AC02-AC07 was reported as reproduced by the parent task. This file did not rerun repository code.
Contract checks can validate input structure and deliberately invalid arguments, but cannot validate rule inference, clinical correctness or efficacy.
Reviewed premises are synthetic teaching data only. Production implementations must authenticate the review source and must not accept LLM self-signing.
Run each acceptance case in an isolated test host. The host loads trusted_server_fixture separately; it is not a model tool argument.
AC31-AC32 specify independent educational outputs without releasing real-case candidates; AC27/AC33 specify that both an empty value and omission run no point-selection methods.
AC36 is a positive case for purely theoretical comparison. AC37 checks subject and historical scope. AC38/AC39 contain deliberately invalid audit arguments, not clinical rejections.

Vendored into TaoChronos for tests/test_acupuncture_reasoning.py (ADR 0027): the cases as delivered; the test host re-issues each trusted_server_fixture through a signed ReviewStore, bound to the current knowledge and rule versions.
